messages.subject: secr 4.6.4
parts: secr 4.6.4 is now on CRAN. This version adds some simulation options e.g., the log-gaussian Cox distribution of activity centres (via the 'rLGCP' function of spatstat that in turn requires the non-CRAN package RandomFields -- see ?sim.popn). Multi-session data may now be fitted with  parameters for the initial density and session-on-session rate of increase (lambda) (see secr-trend.pdf). Other minor changes are listed in NEWS.
